dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and continuous without visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light grey; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey mottling distributed across the posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey mottled regions and the white baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A linear series of small, dark, high-contrast marks or punctate spots is visible along the central longitudinal dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle topological disruptions and shadow-casting along the longitudinal dorsal ridge, appearing as small, sequential indentations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A row of dark, punctate marks or small indentations following the path of the dorsal ridge.
